snippet.title: Announcement Trailer | Minor Deity | Imagine It, Create It, Govern It
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3876240/Minor_Deity/
Join Our Discord: https://discord.gg/2NEb4HxwhF

Announcing Minor Deity.

Command the elements to create the landscapes of your imagination in this gridless, interactive world-building sandbox. Control dynamic weather and allow vegetation and animals to flourish. Lay out towns for growing populations, establish resource outposts, and encourage trade via road, river and sea routes.

Music: The Beginning by @kylemisko
